race.comment: RUSSIAN ESCAPE (7) has not saluted since his maiden win in October 2025 but recent form has been solid. Came from worse than midfield on the corner to get up for second last start over 1400m at Coonabarabran. Drops 3 kg and the extra 100m is to his advantage. Great chance to break the drought. JASON DARREN (3) led for home but was probably a run short last time out when a tiring fourth in a similar race to this at Muswellbrook. Third-up today and has filled a placing at this stage of the prep at every attempt. Should give them something to catch. UNCLE HARRY (1) has been in work for a while and is finding wins hard to come by. Closed well to get up for second in the same race as JASON DARREN at Muswellbrook recently. Doubt he has room to improve on that run but another top three finish is on the cards. GOLDEN HONOUR (4) backs up six days after a decent fourth in the Kempsey Cup. Should be competitive at this level. ROSE WATER (2) can run a big race first-up from a 110-day spell.
